2026_02_CLE_TB.headline: Cleveland’s reshuffled interior line faces Tampa Bay’s fastest route to disruption
2026_02_CLE_TB.paragraph1: Cleveland enters Tampa without guard Teven Jenkins, putting extra stress on an interior protection unit that must account for Calijah Kancey’s quick pressure. Tyson Campbell is questionable in the Browns secondary, while Tampa Bay carries uncertainty around Miles Killebrew, Jalen McMillan and Jacob Parrish. Cleveland needs its run game to keep the offense out of obvious passing downs; the Buccaneers can seize control by compressing the pocket and forcing longer third downs.
2026_02_CLE_TB.model_rationale: Interior protection, early-down balance and Tampa Bay’s ability to create pressure without overcommitting extra rushers are the clearest levers for offensive consistency in this matchup.
